items.title: Introduction
items.desc: Single source of truth architecture and multi-stack overview.

items.title: Theme & Tokens
items.desc: Color palette, semantic mappings, radius and typography.

items.title: Theme Studio
items.desc: Interactive theme customizer and config exporter.

items.title: Typography Rendering
items.desc: Global text rasterizer policy and a five-script size ramp previewing every type scale step.

items.title: Icon System
items.desc: One icon specification for both stacks: single geometry source, one stroke weight, optical centring by construction, and how to switch specifications.

items.title: Button
items.desc: A versatile button component with multiple variants, sizes, and states.

items.title: Badge
items.desc: Displays a badge or status tag to highlight status, tags, and counts.

items.title: Label
items.desc: Renders an accessible label associated with form controls.

items.title: Separator
items.desc: Visually or semantically separates content in horizontal or vertical orientation.

items.title: Skeleton
items.desc: Used to show a placeholder while content is loading with pulse animations.

items.title: Copy Button
items.desc: One-click clipboard copy button with transient feedback icons and custom timeouts.

items.title: Split Button
items.desc: Dual-action button with primary direct click and secondary dropdown chevron.

items.title: Elided Text
items.desc: Smart single-line text that elides overflow and displays an interactive tooltip only when truncated.

items.title: Input
items.desc: Form text input field with desktop high-density sizing and states.

items.title: Checkbox
items.desc: Control that allows toggling between checked, unchecked, and indeterminate.

items.title: Switch
items.desc: A control that allows toggling binary state with smooth animated transitions.

items.title: Select
items.desc: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from with trigger and indicator.

items.title: Slider
items.desc: Interactive control that allows selecting a numeric value along a track.

items.title: Range Slider
items.desc: Dual-thumb slider for selecting numeric min-max intervals with collision prevention.

items.title: Snap Slider
items.desc: Stepped discrete slider that snaps to defined stops with ticks and label row.

items.title: Segmented Control
items.desc: Compact pill segmented switch for toolbars, menus, and view toggles.

items.title: ColorPicker
items.desc: Interactive color selection with saturation/brightness field and swatches.

items.title: Duration Input
items.desc: Segmented duration input with step buttons, keyboard arrow jumping, and preset menu.

items.title: Preset Number Input
items.desc: Numeric input field with quick-select preset dropdown panel and clear actions.

items.title: Read-Only Input
items.desc: Protected input field for tokens and IDs with integrated copy-to-clipboard action.

items.title: Inline Editable Text
items.desc: Text element that switches seamlessly to an input field on double-click or edit trigger.

items.title: Keybinding Recorder
items.desc: Interactive recorder that captures accelerator keyboard sequences for desktop apps.

items.title: Card
items.desc: Displays a card with header, title, description, content, and footer actions.

items.title: Panel Card
items.desc: Card surface with integrated collapsible sections and header action slots.

items.title: Tabs
items.desc: Set of layered content sections known as tab panels, displayed one at a time.

items.title: Scroll Area
items.desc: Custom scrollable container with hot-zone expansion and stepper buttons.

items.title: Collapsible
items.desc: An interactive component which expands and collapses a panel of content.

items.title: Setting Row
items.desc: Settings form item layout with title, description, control slot, and anchor flash.

items.title: Viewport Constrained Container
items.desc: Container that dynamically bounds max-height based on available viewport space below the anchor.

items.title: Sidebar
items.desc: Composable, responsive and resizable desktop-grade sidebar navigation system.

items.title: Splitter
items.desc: Multi-pane resizable layout container with draggable gutters and collapse limits.

items.title: Splitter Handle
items.desc: Edge resize handle with reference item coordinate stabilization and min/max clamping.

items.title: Resizable
items.desc: Accessible resizable panel groups and layout splitters.

items.title: Dialog
items.desc: Modal window that interrupts the user with critical content.

items.title: Alert Dialog
items.desc: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and requires confirmation.

items.title: Sheet
items.desc: Extends the dialog component to display content that slides in from any screen edge.

items.title: Popover
items.desc: Displays rich interactive content in a floating portal anchored to a trigger.

items.title: Tooltip
items.desc: Popup that displays information related to an element on hover or focus.

items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.desc: Displays a menu to the user triggered by a button with item groups and shortcuts.

items.title: Context Menu
items.desc: Displays a menu located at the pointer coordinates on right-click or context gesture.

items.title: Draggable Modal
items.desc: Desktop floating window with dragging title bar and bound viewport constraints.

items.title: Scale OSD
items.desc: Floating on-screen display pill for canvas zoom and scale adjustments with auto-hide.

items.title: Task HUD
items.desc: Floating task progress and notification HUD stack for background executions.

items.title: Window Title Bar
items.desc: Desktop window frame header with title, drag region, and minimize/maximize/close buttons.

items.title: Smooth Wheel Handler
items.desc: Desktop kinematic scrolling helper with continuous damping, Shift-horizontal conversion, and gesture mutex.

items.title: Virtual List
items.desc: High-performance windowed 100k+ row list with dynamic or fixed item measurements.

items.title: Virtual Tree
items.desc: Virtualized hierarchical tree view with node expansion, selection, and keyboard navigation.

items.title: Virtual Grid
items.desc: 2D windowed grid virtualizer for massive dataset visualization.

items.title: Generic Data Table
items.desc: Full-featured data table with column sorting, filtering, selection, and pagination.

items.title: Table
items.desc: Responsive, accessible table component for tabular data.

items.title: Query Builder
items.desc: Visual rule tree builder for structured query generation with nested logic groups.

items.title: Code Block
items.desc: Spec-driven syntax-highlighted code viewer composed from scroll, copy, and tab primitives.

items.title: Pipeline View
items.desc: Multi-stage execution view and pipeline center with job tracking, step timelines, and virtualized auto-scrolling log console.

items.title: Address Bar
items.desc: Explorer and browser-style navigation bar with interactive breadcrumbs and inline path editing.

items.title: Theme Settings
items.desc: Cross-stack theme settings controller managing mode, accent palette, decoration level, and UI density.

items.title: Language Settings
items.desc: Cross-stack language configuration card with system detection and cultural poetry quotes.
